title: Transport functions for principal bundles and Morse homology with differential graded coefficients
summary: We study transport functions as a Morse-theoretical way of describing principal bundles. Transport functions are maps from the spaces of broken gradient flow lines to a topological group and they encode the transition functions of the principal bundle. We describe and extend a construction by Voigt that yields such transport functions and show that one can recover the principal bundle from the transport function.
